violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed drink shaker containers and lids located at the front counter are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours. The shakers are being rinsed between uses, but not properly sanitized as often as required.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. The EHS discussed this with the PIC. Please wash, rinse and sanitize the shakers (and the stirring spoons) at least every four hours.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN WAREWASHIING AREA COMPLETELY COVERED WITH BOXES AND EGG CARTONS. OBSERVED FOOD RESIDUE AND A BLENDER CAP IN THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE BOBA AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: ITEMS REMOVED, PIC AND EMPLOYEES RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED TEMPURA SHRIMP AT 45F (1HR) IN A CONTAINER STACKED ON OTHER FOOD IN TWO-DOOR PREP TOP IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED ON NOT STACKING FOOD IN PREP-TOP. SHRIMP PLACED ON THE SHELVES IN THE BOTTOM OF THE COOLER.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED NO DATE MARKING ON SITE.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED ON DATE MARKING.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment. OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER PRESENT AT FACILITY DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST ALWAYS BE PRESENT WHILE FACILITY IS IN OPERATION. ONE 1EA TAIWANESE CAFE & TEA (Inspection Date: 06/16/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED FOOD WORKER WASH HANDS WITH WATER IN THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. CDI: EHS CORRECTED FOOD WORKER AND THEY WASHED THEIR HANDS PROPERLY IN THE HANDWASHING SINK.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED FOOD WORKER IN BACK WASHING HANDS IN THREE-VAT SINK. OBSERVED DIFFERENT FOOD WORKER WASHING HANDS IN THREE-VAT SINK AT TEA BAR.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. CDI: FOOD WORKERS CORRECTED. ONLY HANDWASHING SINKS MAY BE USED FOR HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed TEA MIXING CONTAINERS located at the TEA BAR that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours. OBSERVED THESE CONTAINERS ONLY BEING WASHED WITH HOT WATER.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. CDI: RE-EDUCATED FOOD WORKER ON WASHING, RINSING, AND SANITIZING EVERY FOUR HOURS. ITEMS TO BE PROPERLY WASHED, RINSED, SANITIZED IN THE BACK 3-VAT SINK.

violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: ONLY OBSERVED A FEW ITEMS DATE MARKED.

These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. ALL TCS FOODS THAT ARE KEPT ON SITE FOR OVER 24 HOURS MUST BE DATE MARKED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLES OF CHEMICALS NOT LABELED.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. LABEL ALL UNLABELED WORKING CONTAINERS OF CHEMICALS SUCH AS CLEANERS OR SANITIZERS. MUST BE LABELED WITH COMMON NAME.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of FOOD. OBSERVED MULTIPLE CONTAINERS OF SOY-SAUCE USED FOR DRY STORAGE. OBSERVED SPICE CONTAINERS REUSED FOR OTHER FOODS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. CEASE RE-USING MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS FOR FOODS. PURCHASE NSF APPROVED OR THE EQUIVALENT FOOD CONTAINERS TO USE.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. CHLORINE TEST KIT ONSITE EXPIRED 3 YEARS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a test kit. OBTAIN A CHLORINE (BLEACH) TEST KIT TO ENSURE YOU ARE PROPERLY SANITIZING SURFACES.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE EATING OVER A FOOD PREP SURFACE AND THEN STIRRING FOOD.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE TO THE DINING ROOM TO FINISH EATING. ONE 1EA TAIWANESE CAFE & TEA (Inspection Date: 11/06/2024) Page 2 of 3
